newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani money market rates fluctuate widely.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani money market rates fluctuate widely.

text.p: Pakistani money market rates closed sharply up on Monday after fluctuating widely amid a fund inflow from the maturity of an open market operation in the beginning and borrowing pressure before the close, dealers said.

Overnight rates opened at 12 percent, dropped to 5.00 percent after the inflow of 1.4 billion rupees from the marker operation maturity and closed at 15 percent after heavy borrowing, one dealer at the Standard Chartered Bank, Karachi, said.
"It is expected that the rates tomorrow will stay at the same level tomorrow," the dealer said.
